# CloudTracer

> Command-line tool that scans a website and prints registrar, DNS, CDN, hosting, SSL, email, and third-party services as a single tree.

CloudTracer is an open-source CLI (Apache-2.0) for auditing your stack, vetting a vendor, or understanding a competitor's infrastructure. Install with `npx cloudtracer example.com` or `npm install -g cloudtracer`. Requires Node.js 20+.

## Docs

- [Home](https://cloudtracer.dev/index.md): Overview, install, options, and example output.
- [Agent guide](https://cloudtracer.dev/AGENTS.md): Project metadata, glossary, and citation conventions for AI agents.
- [Sitemap](https://cloudtracer.dev/sitemap.md): All public URLs.
